PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE DBS BANK | Business Analyst | Apr 2026 – Present Project: Payments Operations & Processing Transformation • Analyzing requirements and business processes across payment operations and end-to-end payment lifecycle, including payment initiation,
authentication, authorization, validation, routing, transaction processing, payment status tracking (successful/failed/pending), reversals, refunds, chargebacks, exceptions, reconciliation, and settlement across UPI, IMPS, NEFT, RTGS, cards, and international cross-border payments (SWIFT).
Contributed to Target Operating Model (TOM) definition and payment operating model enhancements by evaluating current-state processes, designing future-state workflows, aligning business capabilities, operating procedures, and system interactions to support scalable payment operations and digital transformation initiatives.
Conducting AS-IS/TO-BE analysis, identifying process gaps, and documenting BRDs, Functional Requirements, business rules, process flows, user stories, acceptance criteria, and API requirements for payment-related enhancements involving payment gateways, payment processors, PSPs, issuer/acquirer banks, core banking systems (CBS), merchant systems, and payment networks (NPCI, Visa, Mastercard, and SWIFT).
Collaborating with business, operations, product, technology, QA, and compliance stakeholders to clarify requirements, analyse system integrations, API dependencies, data flows, payment interfaces, notification services, fraud/AML checks, reconciliation and settlement systems, support SIT/UAT, validate payment scenarios, and manage defects through successful delivery.
AXIS BANK | Business Analyst | Aug 2024 – Mar 2026 Project: Digital Payments & Transaction Processing Enhancement • Analyzed end-to-end payment workflows covering payment initiation, authentication, authorization, validation, routing, processing,
successful/failed/pending transactions, reversals, refunds, chargebacks, exception handling, reconciliation, settlement, and payment lifecycle across UPI, IMPS, NEFT, RTGS, cards, and international cross-border payments (SWIFT).
Supported Target Operating Model (TOM) initiatives through current-state assessment, future-state process design, and payment process standardization. • Translated business requirements into BRDs, Functional Requirement Documents (FRDs), user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, and business rules while collaborating with business, operations, product, technology, QA, and compliance stakeholders for domestic and international payment solutions.
Analyzed system interactions and data flows across digital channels, payment gateways, payment processors, merchant systems, PSPs, issuer/acquirer banks, core banking systems (CBS), payment networks (NPCI, Visa, Mastercard, SWIFT), notification services, AML/fraud monitoring, reconciliation, settlement, and reporting platforms; supported SIT/UAT, defect management, API validation, payment message validation (ISO 8583/ISO 20022), and production issue analysis.

technology teams.
Created use cases, user stories, acceptance criteria, and UAT scenarios; supported defect triage and business validation across the SDLC.

customer-care escalation.
Created AS-IS/TO-BE process flows, use cases, functional requirements, business rules, user stories, acceptance criteria, and UAT scenarios. • Analyzed interactions between customers, chatbot services, CRM, customer-care teams, core banking systems, authentication services, and dependent systems; supported UAT, defect triage, and release readiness.
